title: Application Strategies of Super-Enhancer RNA in the Treatment of Cardiovascular Diseases
content: Cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) are a leading cause of death worldwide. In recent years, enhancer RNAs (eRNAs) have gradually attracted attention because they offer new directions for the treatment of CVDs. This article reviews the characteristics of super-enhancer RNAs (seRNAs) and their expression and regulatory mechanisms in the cardiovascular system. We also explore their role in the occurrence and development of CVDs, as well as their potential as diagnostic markers and treatment targets. Currently, therapies targeting seRNAs are a research hotspot. The development of specific inhibitors or activators is expected to facilitate precise interventions for CVDs. In addition, the use of gene editing techniques to modify relevant eRNA introduce new possibilities for disease treatment.
